pathways.title: How to Become a Professional Actuary
pathways.description: A complete roadmap to becoming a qualified actuary, from university studies to professional designation.

steps.title: Complete Your Degree
steps.description: Earn a Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science or a related field from a recognized university.

steps.title: Register with a Professional Body
steps.description: Join a professional actuarial organization such as ASEA or IFoA to begin your qualification journey.

steps.title: Pass Professional Exams
steps.description: Pass a series of professional examinations covering core actuarial principles and practice areas.

steps.title: Gain Work Experience
steps.description: Accumulate practical work experience under qualified actuaries in insurance, pensions, or consulting.

steps.title: Obtain Professional Designation
steps.description: Achieve Fellowship (FSA/FIA) or Associate (ASA/AIA) status with your professional body.

professionalBodies.name: Actuarial Society of East Africa (ASEA)
professionalBodies.description: The regional professional body for actuaries in East Africa, providing professional development, ethics guidance, and regulation.
professionalBodies.focus: East African professional standards, regional networking, and qualification pathways

professionalBodies.name: Institute and Faculty of Actuaries
professionalBodies.description: The oldest and one of the most prestigious actuarial bodies globally, based in the United Kingdom.
professionalBodies.focus: International qualifications, professional standards, and global recognition

professionalBodies.name: Society of Actuaries
professionalBodies.description: A leading global professional organization for actuaries, based in the United States.
professionalBodies.focus: US-based qualifications, research, and professional development

professionalBodies.name: Casualty Actuarial Society
professionalBodies.description: The primary professional organization for property and casualty actuaries.
professionalBodies.focus: Property and casualty insurance, general insurance, and risk management

careerFields.description: Develop and price life insurance products, manage reserves, and analyze mortality experience.

Apply actuarial and statistical techniques to big data, machine learning, and predictive modeling.
Provide actuarial consulting services to a wide range of clients across industries.
